title: Приступ радикулита и бездомный котёнок  (A Bout of Sciatica and a Stray Kitten)

segments.t: During their second morning run in the park, Chef Barinov is on the verge of collapsing when Elena suddenly throws her back out and cannot move an inch. Meanwhile back at the apartment, Max and Kostya hatch a clever plan using a stray kitten to appeal to Nastya's soft heart.
Не могу ни туда, ни сюда.
Вы меня не шевелите, я сама, ладно?
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
'You got here fast.' Mentioning that Max got here fast moves the talk in a new direction. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.

'What is wrong with you?' Asking what wrong with Rodion is cuts straight through the tension between Max and Rodion. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
'What happened to your back?' With the conversation and kitchen hanging in the air, Rodion puts Max on the spot.
'I cannot move.' Explaining that he cannot move lays the cards on the table for Rodion.
Не могу ни туда, ни сюда.
'I cannot move forward or backward.' Rodion mentions that he cannot move forward or backward so Max sees what is at stake.
'Hold on, stop, stop.' Realizing that Rodion should hold on stop stop changes how Max handles the situation.
'Wait, hold still.' Holding still moves the conversation forward without extra drama.
Вы меня не шевелите, я сама, ладно?

'Do not move me, I will try by myself, okay?' Here asking whether not move him he will try by himself okay shows Max looking for the real truth. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
'I can do it myself.' Claiming that he can do it himself sounds confident, even if Max has doubts.
'Bless you.' Between the conversation and the morning, Max gives Rodion a quick, grounded response.

'Rodion Sergeyevich, what happened?' Over the point and the morning, Rodion presses Max for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Are you feeling worse?' Here checking whether Rodion feeling worse shows Max looking for the real truth.
'What a sweet little kitten.' Between the conversation and the kitchen, Rodion gives Max a quick, grounded response. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
Не могу ни туда, ни сюда.
Вы меня не шевелите, я сама, ладно?
That wraps up this scene as during their second morning jog in the park, Elena throws her back out when she bends down, and at the restaurant Max hatches a plan using a stray kitten. Until next time!
